figures.title: Performance against context length
figures.caption: Each point is one run: the prompt size of its last model call against its score, the condition by colour and marker; the lines are each condition's mean score in six log-spaced bands of context, with a 95% bootstrap band. Hollow points come from records that did not keep their calls, approximated as prompt tokens over turns. One panel per subject and model.

figures.title: Best and mean score per condition
figures.caption: Solid bars are each condition's mean score over its runs with a 95% bootstrap interval; hatched bars take the best repetition of each task and average those over tasks. One panel per subject and model.

figures.title: Time per query
figures.caption: Left, the runner's wall time divided by the run's model turns; right, seconds from the start of the run to the start of its answer, by condition. One row per subject and model.

figures.title: Cost against context
figures.caption: Each point is one run: the prompt size of its last model call against what the run cost, condition by colour and marker; hollow points are approximated. One panel per subject and model.
